def transform(grid):
    a=[row[:] for row in grid]
    H,W=len(a),len(a[0])
    sr,sc=next((r,c) for r,row in enumerate(a) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==2)
    row_counts=[sum(v==8 for v in row) for row in a]
    col_counts=[sum(a[r][c]==8 for r in range(H)) for c in range(W)]
    rows_axis=max(row_counts,default=0) >= max(col_counts,default=0)
    if rows_axis:
        walls=[r for r,n in enumerate(row_counts) if n>=max(3,W//2)]
        start_axis,start_perp,limit=sr,sc,H
        def holes(line): return [c for c,v in enumerate(a[line]) if v!=8]
    else:
        walls=[c for c,n in enumerate(col_counts) if n>=max(3,H//2)]
        start_axis,start_perp,limit=sc,sr,W
        def holes(line): return [r for r in range(H) if a[r][line]!=8]
    ahead=[x for x in walls if x!=start_axis]
    if not ahead: return a
    nearest=min(ahead,key=lambda x:abs(x-start_axis))
    sign=1 if nearest>start_axis else -1
    walls=[x for x in walls if (x-start_axis)*sign>0]
    walls.sort(reverse=sign<0)
    prev=start_axis
    incoming=[start_perp]
    def put(ax,p):
        r,c=(ax,p) if rows_axis else (p,ax)
        if a[r][c]!=8: a[r][c]=2
    for wi,w in enumerate(walls):
        lane=w-sign
        # Carry incoming paths toward the adjacent lane before this wall.
        for p in incoming:
            for ax in range(prev+sign,lane+sign,sign):
                if 0<=ax<limit: put(ax,p)
        opens=holes(w)
        crossed=set()
        for p in incoming:
            if p in opens:
                crossed.add(p)
                continue
            left=[x for x in opens if x<p]
            right=[x for x in opens if x>p]
            lo=max(left) if left else 0
            hi=min(right) if right else (W-1 if rows_axis else H-1)
            for x in range(lo,hi+1): put(lane,x)
            crossed.update(x for x in opens if lo<=x<=hi)
        # Cross the wall only at reached openings.
        for p in crossed: put(w,p)
        if wi==len(walls)-1:
            for p in crossed:
                for ax in range(w+sign,limit if sign>0 else -1,sign): put(ax,p)
            break
        prev=w
        incoming=sorted(crossed)
    return a

program_code='''def transform(grid):
    a = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(a), len(a[0])
    sr, sc = next((r, c) for r, row in enumerate(a) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == 2)
    row_counts = [sum(value == 8 for value in row) for row in a]
    col_counts = [sum(a[r][c] == 8 for r in range(h)) for c in range(w)]
    rows_axis = max(row_counts, default=0) >= max(col_counts, default=0)

    if rows_axis:
        walls = [r for r, count in enumerate(row_counts) if count >= max(3, w // 2)]
        start_axis, start_perp, axis_limit = sr, sc, h
        def openings(line):
            return [c for c, value in enumerate(a[line]) if value != 8]
    else:
        walls = [c for c, count in enumerate(col_counts) if count >= max(3, h // 2)]
        start_axis, start_perp, axis_limit = sc, sr, w
        def openings(line):
            return [r for r in range(h) if a[r][line] != 8]

    ahead = [line for line in walls if line != start_axis]
    if not ahead:
        return a
    nearest = min(ahead, key=lambda line: abs(line - start_axis))
    direction = 1 if nearest > start_axis else -1
    walls = [line for line in walls if (line - start_axis) * direction > 0]
    walls.sort(reverse=direction < 0)

    def paint(axis_pos, perp_pos):
        r, c = (axis_pos, perp_pos) if rows_axis else (perp_pos, axis_pos)
        if a[r][c] != 8:
            a[r][c] = 2

    previous_wall = start_axis
    incoming = [start_perp]
    perp_limit = w if rows_axis else h
    for index, wall in enumerate(walls):
        lane = wall - direction
        for position in incoming:
            for axis_pos in range(previous_wall + direction, lane + direction, direction):
                if 0 <= axis_pos < axis_limit:
                    paint(axis_pos, position)

        wall_openings = openings(wall)
        crossed = set()
        for position in incoming:
            if position in wall_openings:
                crossed.add(position)
                continue
            left = [opening for opening in wall_openings if opening < position]
            right = [opening for opening in wall_openings if opening > position]
            low = max(left) if left else 0
            high = min(right) if right else perp_limit - 1
            for perp_pos in range(low, high + 1):
                paint(lane, perp_pos)
            crossed.update(opening for opening in wall_openings if low <= opening <= high)

        for position in crossed:
            paint(wall, position)
        if index == len(walls) - 1:
            for position in crossed:
                for axis_pos in range(wall + direction, axis_limit if direction > 0 else -1, direction):
                    paint(axis_pos, position)
            break
        previous_wall = wall
        incoming = sorted(crossed)
